## Command Panel

Builds a custom control screen out of placeable LEDs, buttons, text, plots,
bargraphs, pictures and meters, then runs it as a locked control surface.
Reached from the main menu as "Command Panel".

### The screen

Opens locked, showing whatever controls have been placed on the current
page. Unlocking (see below) switches into edit mode, where the currently
selected control is highlighted.

If the current page has no controls at all, the screen opens directly in
edit mode and shows a "Load Wili File" touch button in the middle. Tapping
it opens a file picker on the SD card's `wilifiles` folder; picking a
`.wili` project file loads it and rebuilds the panel from its contents.

To make a project load automatically at power-up, put it in
`wilifiles/default/` - the first `.wili` file found there is loaded at
boot.

### Controls

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| Cancel | Toggle between locked (run) mode and unlocked (edit) mode |
| Hold Cancel | This help page |
| AI (unlocked) | Add a new blank page and switch to it |
| AI (locked) | Cycle to the next page |
| Gray (unlocked, editing) | Add a control: LED, Button, Text, Plot, Bargraph, Picture or Meter |
| Yellow (unlocked, editing) | Select the next placed control |
| Green (unlocked, editing) | Switch the arrow keys between moving and resizing the selected control |
| Blue (unlocked, editing) | Edit the selected control's properties |
| Red (unlocked, editing) | Edit the selected control's event |
| Up / Down / Left / Right (unlocked, editing) | Move or resize the selected control, 10 pixels at a time |
| Ok | Leave properties or event editing, back to normal editing |

Holding Cancel to open this page does not change the lock state or which
control is selected, even though a short press of the same button toggles
the lock.

### Locked mode

This is what the screen opens to. If any placed Button controls have been
tagged to the five button-bar positions, those buttons show that button's
own text and run its action instead of the editing tools below - this is
how a finished panel is actually operated. A short press of Cancel unlocks
the page for editing.

### Editing a page

Unlocking selects a control automatically. Green switches what Up, Down,
Left and Right do to the selected control: the button reads "size" when
they currently move it, and "move" when they currently resize it - it always
shows what pressing it will switch you to. Moving or resizing goes in steps
of 10 pixels and is clamped to the screen, roughly 0-470 across and 0-310
down, with a minimum size of 10 pixels.

Blue opens property editing for the selected control - which fields appear
depends on its type: value expression and size for an LED, on/off text and
value for a Button, caption/size/type/value for Text, and so on. Red opens
event editing, which currently only does anything for a Button control (a
"click" expression); other types just leave event mode. Ok backs out of
either editing mode without leaving the screen.

### Pages

A "Command Panel" can hold more than one page. AI behaves differently
depending on lock state: while editing, it adds a brand new blank page and
switches to it; while locked, it instead cycles forward through the pages
you already have, wrapping back to the first after the last.
